items.headline: IMF Warns AI Investment Surge Masks Deepening Global Economic Disparities
items.summary: At the IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that global economic resilience rests on a fragile foundation driven by an artificial intelligence investment boom. She cautioned that while AI spending boosts near-term growth in major tech-producing economies, it risks widening global inequality, disrupting labor markets, and failing to resolve mounting sovereign debt.

items.headline: Global Chip and AI Stocks Plunge Amid Rising Inflation and AI Debt Fears
items.summary: Global artificial intelligence and semiconductor stocks suffered a sharp sell-off on October 15 following higher-than-expected U.S. inflation figures and growing worries over the heavy debt funding AI infrastructure. Major technology shares across Asia and the United States tumbled during the session, reflecting rising investor anxiety over elevated tech valuations and borrowing costs.

items.headline: Cleveland Guardians Defeat Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 to Take 2-1 ALCS Lead
items.summary: The Cleveland Guardians defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 in Game 3 of the American League Championship Series on Thursday, October 15, taking a 2-1 lead in the playoff series. Outfielder Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead two-run home run in the fifth inning, while starting pitcher Gavin Williams struck out nine batters to secure the home victory.

items.headline: Zendaya to Star in Alex Garland's Next A24 Sci-Fi Film
